summary:
Observed in FS.GG.SDD `upgrade` (FS-GG/FS.GG.SDD#1156, merged as #1157).

**The defect.** The apply step recomputes its effect list every tick. Its decision was: all interpreted means resolve; any planned means wait; otherwise emit everything. When the earlier effects are interpreted the list can GROW: the owner-guidance merge into AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md can only be planned once the owner skills it requires are installed, which is a new observation. The two new writes are unplanned, but the step sees "something is planned" and waits for them forever. The loop goes idle and the run ends with outcome succeeded and no upgrade summary at all. It reproduced on the unmodified build as soon as the delivered payload declared owner guidance, and no test had covered a workspace with agent configuration present and the payload files absent.

**The fix.** When some effects are planned, emit exactly the effects not yet planned and wait only when there are none. Any reconcile loop that recomputes its plan each tick needs the same shape: compare against what has already been emitted, never against whether anything has.

**A second cost on the same loop (FS-GG/FS.GG.SDD#1161).** The driver folds one update per interpreted result, and each update re-derived the whole plan (embedded owner packs, every skill body). With the atlas skill present that is hundreds of milliseconds, so a refresh of several hundred files processed about 1.2 results per second and a second run was still going after two minutes when killed. The step now returns at once while a write, removal or mode change it already emitted is in flight and derives the plan again after the last result. Waiting is exactly what the full recomputation concluded, so behavior is unchanged and only the cost goes.

**Related.** Measured while the same bump made `doctor` 36x slower (O(n) effect-log lookups per question); see sdd/driver-pin-bump-repins-goldens-and-lockfiles.

**Scope.** FS.GG.SDD `HandlersUpgrade.applyStage`; the same pattern is worth checking in other handlers that emit a recomputed effect list.
title: An upgrade apply step that waits while anything is planned stalls forever when the effect set grows after the first effects run
